reasons.plausibility: It builds on known mechanisms of oxygen-induced oxidation and carbon retention effects on sintering in high-entropy alloys, making it scientifically credible despite some details needing further validation.
reasons.testability: Clear comparative experiments (SEM, EDS, mechanical tests) in different atmospheres at specified temperatures provide a direct means to confirm or refute the predicted densification and strength outcomes.
reasons.usefulness: Controlling oxygen during debinding and sintering is a practical, relevant approach for improving part quality and reducing processing challenges in DLP-based high-entropy alloy fabrication.
